newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaha forms Taiwan development unit.
newsitem.headline: Yamaha forms Taiwan development unit.

text.p: Yamaha Motor Co Ltd said on Thursday it had formed a new company in Taiwan earlier this month to develop Yamaha brand motorcycle models.
The new company, Yamaha Motor R & D Taiwan Co Ltd, will be capitalised at T$5 million and is owned 80 percent by Yamaha and 20 percent by Yamaha Motor Taiwan Co Ltd (YMT).
YMT, owned 51 percent by Yamaha and 49 percent by a Taiwanese investment company, produces 410,000 motorcycles a year and exports about 50,000 per year, mainly to Europe and Latin America.
The new company will primarily develop scooters for YMT, but also plans to develop motorcycles for Yamaha's other overseas production bases.
The company will start operations in April with 80 employees and a sales target of T$100 million in the first year and T$150 million in 2000.
Taiwan's motorcycle demand stands at about one million units a year, mostly for 50cc to 125cc scooters.
